answer: The bridge is that the bill for trying is 70 separate visits, each one billed £7 at the door, due at the door for every name. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the horizon proves it. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. No Inspected hatter waybill token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token hatters wear after shop inspections is why it holds. The tally keeps quartz.
